## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update junit-framework monorepo by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2451
* Fix conformance test summary reporting by emitting the expected failure information as structured JSON by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2437
* Fix uncaught exception during stub shutdown with in-flight delay by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2453
* chore(deps): update jackson monorepo to v2.21.3 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2456
* Add conformance tests for query params and validate that query params as objects are not supported by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2462
* Add a conformance test to validate optional request bodies in posts by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2463
* Add a conformance test demonstrating that Specmatic doesn't respect the defaults of additionalProperties = true by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2464
* chore(deps): update dependency io.specmatic.build-reporter:specmatic-reporter-min to v0.3.15 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2460
* Validate request & response headers in conformance tests by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2470
* Extern command options for validate and backward compatibility by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2466
* Add count and progress indicator to Backward Compatibility Check by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2472
* Add operation verdict to Backward Compatibility Check by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2473


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.44.2...2.45.0
